projections.before:
- name: Build and verify Cloudflare Worker
        run: |
          npm run cf:build --workspace @probpera/admin
          npm run cf:size --workspace @probpera/admin

      - name: Verify preseeded private admin catalogs
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          ADMIN_EDITORIAL_CATALOG_SHA256: ${{ vars.ADMIN_EDITORIAL_CATALOG_SHA256 }}
          ADMIN_INTERFACE_COPY_CATALOG_SHA256: ${{ vars.ADMIN_INTERFACE_COPY_CATALOG_SHA256 }}
projections.after:
- name: Build and verify Cloudflare Worker
        run: |
          npm run cf:build --workspace @probpera/admin
          npm run cf:size --workspace @probpera/admin

      - name: Smoke-test built Worker in local workerd
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: node scripts/smoke-admin-workerd.mjs

      - name: Verify preseeded private admin catalogs
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          ADMIN_EDITORIAL_CATALOG_SHA256: ${{ vars.ADMIN_EDITORIAL_CATALOG_SHA256 }}
          ADMIN_INTERFACE_COPY_CATALOG_SHA256: ${{ vars.ADMIN_INTERFACE_COPY_CATALOG_SHA256 }}

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { projectReviewedAdminWorkerCompatibility } from './reviewed-admin-worker-compatibility.mjs';

deltas.after:
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { projectReviewedAdminWorkerCompatibility } from './reviewed-admin-worker-compatibility.mjs';
